description: Apply a saved pose file to a character. A pose restores the whole body state at once: base animation, every IK and FK bone target, and the expression category flags. 'path' must come from studio_list_poses, and the pose's sex must match the character's. To set only the base animation instead, use studio_set_character_anime. Not undoable from Studio.

output.description: the character, same shape as one entry of studio_list_characters — check 'anime' and 'kinematic' to confirm the pose was applied
